_readme: AN INVENTED LAYER (COLLECTION.md §5, 'when the evidence is thin, invent the layer'). 8VC runs ~30 single-deal SPVs whose Form Ds name no portfolio company — every one files as 'Indefinite / $0 sold', investmentFundType 'Venture Capital Fund', with 8VC SPV GP I, LLC, Eight Partners VC, LLC and Joe Lonsdale as executive officers at 907 S Congress Avenue. What the filings DO carry is the vehicle's name and its filing date, and the names are codes of the form <company initials> + S + <round letter>: ADSF = ADdepar Series F, ANSD/ANSE/ANSF = ANduril Series D/E/F, EPSD = EPirus Series D, PAIC = PathAI Series C. SCORED before use, per §5 rule 1, against the announced round dates: five of six resolved codes have their Form D filed within six weeks of the round announcement (ADSF -6wk, ANSD -5wk, PAIC -4wk, ANSF -2wk, EPSD -3wk); the sixth, ANSE, was formed six months before the Series E closed. The layer is therefore CORROBORATION, not a label: a code alone never names a company (two letters are ambiguous), but a code whose prefix, round letter and filing date all line up with a documented round is affirmative evidence that an 8VC VEHICLE took a position in that company at that round. That is exactly the evidence Delta A turns on, and it is what puts Addepar, Anduril, PathAI, Epirus and Saronic inside the base on fund money rather than on a site listing. Evidence class fund_filing.

scored.method: days between the SPV's first Form D and the company's announced round

codes.basis: Addepar's $150M Series F at $2.17B was announced 2021-06-16, six weeks after the SPV filed.
Addepar's $230M Series G at $3.25B followed in 2025.
Anduril's $450M Series D at $4.6B was announced 2021-06-17.
Anduril's $1.48B Series E at $8.48B closed 2022-12; the SPV was formed six months ahead — the one outlier in the score.
Anduril's $1.5B Series F at $14B was announced 2024-08-08, two weeks later. A second vehicle, ANSF SPV I-A, filed the same day.
Epirus's $250M Series D was announced 2025-03; EPSD SPV I-A filed the same day.
PathAI's $165M Series C was announced 2021-05-11, four weeks later.
Named in full. Saronic's $175M Series B closed 2024-08; SPV II and II-A filed 2025-02-27 around the $600M Series C.

_unresolved_note: Left unresolved rather than guessed: a two-letter prefix has many candidates in a 318-row book and §3's null-over-force-fit rule applies to an evidence layer as much as to a column. They are listed so the next pass, or the next run, can close them against dated rounds.
